requiredBeforePublished: all source ids attached and accepted by content QA
safety review completed for labs/microscope/safety-sensitive items

importNotes: Content-PROD-2 may import as draft data only.
Do not publish any item with verificationStatus=source_required or needs_methodist_review.
Student sections are catalog-only placeholders, not lessons.
Lab, simulation and microscope references are planning links until reviewed scenarios/assets exist.
OpenStax, ACS and official curriculum sources are reference candidates; do not copy source prose or figures into Allchemist without legal review.

contentItemsRequire: curriculum-map-school-mvp.json loaded before school item publication checks
sourceIds in each item/task exist in source pack
uiCardsRequire: referenced contentItemId exists or catalogSectionId exists
verificationStatus matches referenced content item for school cards

validationRules: Every JSON file must parse successfully.

Every school content item must have id, subject, educationLevel, grade, topic, title, summary, learningObjectives, blocks, tasks, sourceMetadata, verificationStatus, copyrightPolicy and lastReviewedAt.
Every sourceMetadata.sourceIds entry must exist in source-pack-mvp.json.
Every task must carry sourceMetadata and verificationStatus.
No item may have publicationAllowed=true or copyrightPolicy.allowedForPublication=true until approved in a later task.
No item may use verificationStatus=approved in Content-PROD-2.
Textbook placeholders do not count as publication approval.
Lab, safety, simulation and microscope references must remain draft-only until reviewed scenarios/assets exist.
failImportIf: duplicate id appears within one imported collection
sourceIds reference an unknown source id
ui card references a missing content item or missing catalog section
draftOnlyIf: source pack contains only reviewed_candidate sources and textbook placeholders
